name: Numbers on screen
description: Use when a video shows charts or numbers: every figure comes from the person's file or words, charts are simple and labelled, animation reveals rather than decorates, and nothing is invented or rounded into a claim.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.

evals.ask: Add an animated chart of our sales to the video
Show the numbers on screen as he says them
Fix the chart rendering bug in the dashboard
